parameters.componentSubtitle: Flexible content slot with a fixed circular play icon

description.component: Full-width horizontal card with a flexible content slot and a fixed circular play icon in one of two brand colors. The heading in the slot underlines on hover.

icon_color.name: Icon color
icon_color.description: Bootstrap theme color for the circular icon background.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Brand background color applied to the card.

corner_style.name: Border radius
corner_style.description: Bootstrap rounded utility applied to the card.

padded.name: Padded
padded.description: Adds Bootstrap padding (p-4) to the card.

content_vertical_alignment.name: Content vertical alignment
content_vertical_alignment.description: Vertical alignment of the content slot and icon within the row.

stretched_link.name: Stretched link
stretched_link.description: When enabled and a Card link URL is provided, the entire card becomes clickable.

link_url.name: Card link URL
link_url.description: Optional URL for the card link. Only used when Stretched link is enabled.

link_target.name: Link target
link_target.description: Where to open the card link.
